description: U+FEFF incidental (1), competing explanation: the stored form of a leading U+FEFF (bytes FF FE) could collide with the Unicode-compression marker. ADO DDL tries CREATE TABLE WC with T TEXT(255) WITH COMPRESSION and M MEMO WITH COMPRESSION, and WN without; rows lone U+FEFF, U+FEFF ab, ab U+FEFF, ab go into each table that exists by SQL literal (dbFailOnError); each table's Properties (UnicodeCompression among them) are listed for T and M; then a DAO snapshot of ID, T, Len(T), Len(M) per table. Asks whether the compressed and the uncompressed column differ.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-wire probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
